title: A cut click, Undo and a dropped clip on a video answer inside 50 ms
goal: On a video, clicking a cut, pressing Undo or Redo, and letting a second clip go on the timeline each still keep the app busy for 57 to 77 ms, over the 50 ms the Premiere goal sets for every press on the timeline. Bring these three under it. This is the part of the edit-speed work that does not wait on the key lane card, so it can be done now. It also finds out whether the 760 ms hold seen right after the second clip lands in the scripted editing session is the app or the walk, and fixes it if it is the app.
